Get ready for the best Halloween ever with the ultimate Halloween music playlist! 

🎃 Enjoy the top Halloween songs of all time, featuring spooky classics, unforgettable Halloween hits, and the perfect music to bring your Halloween celebration to life.

PERFECT FOR:

● Halloween parties and costume celebrations

● Spooky season and October festivities

● Haunted house and Halloween decorations

● Halloween night with friends and family

● Trick-or-treating and Halloween celebrations

● Anyone who loves classic Halloween songs

Turn up the volume, embrace the spooky atmosphere, and enjoy an unforgettable Halloween night filled with music, mystery, and fun!

snippet.title: A Dickens of a Christmas at Castle Howard | Theatrical Trailer
snippet.description:
This Victorian extravaganza will leave you full to the brim with festive cheer! Charles Dickens’ classic novels are brought to life in grand Christmas style, leaping off the page with projections, soundscapes, and theatrical surprises. Opening 12th November.

As the cold nights draw in, warm your hands and hearts by the grand roaring fire and encounter familiar faces from Dickens' most treasured novels, including Ebenezer Scrooge and a ghost or two. Rich in nostalgia, storytelling and Christmas spirit, it's an immersive journey that celebrates Christmas magic. Following the award-winning success of Christmas at Castle Howard with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz and Alice's Christmas Wonderland, CLW Event Design and imitating the dog return to bring this joyful experience to life.

Book tickets: https://www.castlehoward.co.uk/whats-on/christmas-at-castle-howard 

Castle Howard, 30 minutes from York

North Yorkshire, YO607DA

yuri is one of the two tritagonists (alongside natsuki), as well as the secondary antagonist of the visual novel doki doki literature club!, one of the five members of the literature club, later replacing sayori as the vice-president in act 2 after she was deleted by monika in act 1.yuri joined the literature club out of her interest in fantasy and psychological horror novels. as of act 2, she became the game's secondary antagonist, although she is not really a villain, just a victim. yuri and natsuki are always playing together and sometimes yuri can abuse natsuki on some occasions. however, yuri thinks that natsuki is perfect and that she's a good friend. doki doki literature club! (ddlc) is a 2017 freeware visual novel developed by american independent game studio team salvato for linux, macos, and windows. the game was initially distributed through itch.io, and later became available on steam. the story is told from the perspective of a high school student who reluctantly joins the school's literature club on the insistence of his childhood best friend, and is given the option to romantically pursue three of its four female members. doki doki literature club! features a non-traditional plot structure with multiple endings and unlockable cutscenes with each of the main characters. although the game initially appears to be a lighthearted dating simulator, it is in fact a metafictional psychological horror game that extensively breaks the fourth wall.

mikan tsumiki is a character featured in danganronpa 2: goodbye despair. she has the title of ultimate nurse (super high school level health committee member). after catching despair disease in chapter 3 and regaining her memory, she set up a plan to murder ibuki mioda, who also contracted despair disease, but ended up murdering both ibuki and hiyoko saionji after the latter witnessed her attempt to murder ibuki. she had murdered for “the sake of her beloved”. but in reality, mikan, including ibuki and hiyoko, are still alive. danganronpa 2: goodbye despair is a 2012 visual novel developed by spike chunsoft. it is the second game in the danganronpa franchise following danganronpa: trigger happy havoc (2010). it was first released in japan for playstation portable in july 2012, and a port for playstation vita was released in japan in october 2013.development of the game started as kazutaka kodaka was writing the light novel prequel danganronpa zero and added hints about a sequel to the novel following their approval. kodaka aimed to develop a unique plot to give players more mysterious elements in a group of islands, inspired by the television series lost. the protagonist hajime hinata is part of a group of high-school students who are trapped on a tropical island by their high school's headmaster monokuma, a sentient stuffed bear, along with monomi, a sentient stuffed rabbit. similar to the first game, to leave the island, students must kill one of their peers and not be caught in the subsequent investigation and trial.

Worlds 2026 returns to North America for a month of international competition across 3 locations. The Play-In Stage features a 4-team, double-elimination bracket, which qualifies one team into the Swiss Stage— where they will join 15 challengers from around the global to compete for the Summoners Cup at the Grand Final in New York City.

To learn more about the Worlds format, check out https://riot.com/worlds2026format

Swiss Stage: October 23-31

Quarter Finals: November 3-6

Semi Finals: November 7-8

Grand Final: November 14

Welcome back to Species: Unknown full gameplay! We take a look at the brand new Map called HGC Stormrock!

Follow Me Here:
➜ http://instagram.com/thefoosterchannel 
➜ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/thafooster

ABOUT SPECIES: UNKNOWN
Form a squad of up to 4 players to take on different contracts with escalating difficulty. Each mission plays differently depending on your objective, your teammates, the map and which of the 5 intelligent threats is stalking you. No one survives alone, but you can try. 
Every contract drops you into a different nightmare. Whether you're tasked with extracting a black box, capturing or eliminating an unknown threat, or even destroying the ship to prevent the creature from escaping… Each mission demands a specific strategy and none of them are easy.
The specimen is chosen procedurally from a growing roster of terrifying monsters. Each one comes with distinct behaviors, hunting patterns, strengths, and weaknesses. You’ll need to investigate your surroundings to gather vital clues and identify the threat in order to proceed smoothly (or not). Do your job and get rewarded, or die without anyone knowing.

snippet.title: JJ vs Mikey vs Friends: STRANGE STAIRS BATTLE In Minecraft!
snippet.description:
JJ vs Mikey vs Friends: STRANGE STAIRS BATTLE In Minecraft!

#minecraft  #maizen 

The Minecraft videos presented here are professionally produced entertainment projects created by a studio team of more than 20 specialists. All major creative decisions are developed internally, from the original idea and written script to custom level design, handcrafted environments, and the complete story arc.
When familiar characters appear, they are used within newly developed narratives that place them in different fictional circumstances. Their recognizable appearance functions as a visual reference for the audience, a practice commonly found in animation, comics, and online entertainment. We believe the creative purpose of this approach should be communicated clearly.

These videos are intended to contribute to a diverse media experience rather than take the place of educational resources. Evaluating them as though their primary objective were formal instruction would fail to reflect the type of content being produced.
Entertainment offers value through imagination, storytelling, and engagement. This format focuses on age-appropriate situations, consistent narrative patterns, clear story logic, and interactions between characters that highlight cooperation.

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons and missions of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, including the enormous Astaroth .57 anti-materiel rifle, THAT nightclub mission, and an absolutely cursed ‘modernised’ PPSh-41.

00:00 - Intro
01:09 - Haijin City Invasion
01:57 - Han 86
07:08 - Krait P68 / Nightclub Mission
09:41 - MAR-9
14:03 - PM-40 Anvil
16:48 - Why not check out our Patreon?
17:14 - Astaroth .57
19:41 - PPSh-41
25:49 - M4
28:15 - Type 73
30:55 - X-58 Nyx
34:04 - Patriot XMR

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down the guns of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/

snippet.title: WAS ALL THIS WORTH IT? | Beans and Alpacas FS25 - Episode 11
snippet.description:
Order now! - https://www.farming-simulator.com/dlc-detail.php?dlc_id=fs25beansandalpacas&code=DAGGERWIN

Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!
Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay
Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles
Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details
Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

Music by Epidemic Sound

snippet.title: I Made Every AI Play Detroit: Become Human
snippet.description:
For the very last time, we make AI play Detroit: Become Human, but this time we have a few more decision-makers...

This time we follow ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude as they make the decision on behalf of Connor, Marcus, and Kara. 

In this series, we have upgraded the methodology by not telling the AIs they are playing a game, but instead making real-life choices, used pseudonyms for each character, and standardised inputs wherever possible.

But this time we got outcomes that I've never seen before and honestly never expected to happen, so I hope you guys enjoy the video and have a lovely rest of your day.
